nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What factors influence the adoption of eco-friendly faux leather according to Kim et al. (2016)?
nodes.answer: According to Kim et al. (2016), factors influencing the adoption of eco-friendly faux leather include consumer perceptions of the product's environmental benefits, its quality, and its affordability.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What does the term "green products" encompass, according to Galvanize et al. (2016)?
nodes.answer: Green products refer to toxic-free items that are manufactured and recycled in a manner that strengthens environmental stability and safety. This includes aspects like product packaging, production, recycling, energy conservation, and waste disposal, focusing on environmental accountability.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the effects of green consumption values on consumer responses to environmentally friendly products?
nodes.answer: Green consumption values can lead consumers to prefer and actively seek out environmentally friendly products. These values can influence their purchasing decisions and drive the demand for sustainable products in the market.
